unixctl_path.description: Path to the control socket for runtime management commands. Set to 'none' to disable.

vtep_db_url.description: Connection string for the VTEP database. Formats: ssl:host:port, tcp:host:port, unix:file.

ovnsb_db_url.description: Connection string for the OVN Southbound database. Formats: ssl:host:port, tcp:host:port, unix:file.

private_key_path.description: Path to the PEM file containing the private key for SSL/TLS.

certificate_path.description: Path to the PEM file containing the certificate for SSL/TLS.

ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate file for verifying peer certificates. Set to 'none' to disable verification.

bootstrap_ca_cert_path.description: Path to the CA certificate file for bootstrapping trust. Mutually exclusive with ca_cert_path.

peer_ca_cert_path.description: Path to a PEM file with additional CA certificates to send to peers.
